source_refs.note: 3- Identifying Host–Pathogen Interactions: a main subheading of 7.1 Applications of structural biology, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 171-172.

blocks.text: Structural biology yeh samajhne mein bhi madad deti hai ke pathogens (beemari phailane wale, jaise viruses ya bacteria) host (jis ke jism mein woh aate hain) ke cells ke saath kaise milte hain. Ise host–pathogen interaction kehte hain. Pathogen aur host cell dono ke proteins ki 3D structure dekh kar scientists jaan lete hain ke pathogen host cell se kaise chipakta aur andar jata hai, aur is mein kaun se molecules shamil hain. Misal: scientists ne coronavirus ka spike protein parha jo virus ki satah (surface) se bahar nikla hota hai. Unhon ne insani cells ka woh protein bhi dekha jo spike protein ka receptor (pakadne wala) hai. Is tarah pata chala ke virus insani cells mein bilkul kaise dakhil hota hai. Yeh maloomat aisi dawaein banane mein bohat kaam aayi jo receptor proteins se jud jati hain. Aisi dawa virus ko receptor se milne nahi deti, is liye virus host cells mein dakhil nahi ho pata.

blocks.alt: Insani cell ki satah (neeli) jis par do hare Y-numa ACE2 receptors hain. Upar ek gol SARS-CoV-2 zarra jis par spike proteins hain, ek ACE2 se jura hai (SARS-CoV-2 spike protein binding to ACE2). Neeche daen doosra virus membrane ki jeb mein cell ke andar le jaya ja raha hai (Viral entry, replication, and ACE2 normal function blocked).
blocks.caption: Figure 7.2: Corona virus ka insani cell ke receptor se jurne ka tareeqa (kitab ki Figure 7.2 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Virus ke kaante (spike proteins) cell ki satah ke ACE2 receptor mein chabi ki tarah fit hote hain. Judne ke baad virus cell mein dakhil ho kar apni copies banata hai aur ACE2 apna aam kaam nahi kar pata. Structural biology se yeh jodh dekh kar aisi dawa ya vaccine banai ja sakti hai jo spike aur ACE2 ka milna rok de.
